title: You don't get what is promised!
text: You don't get what is promised!. I can't even describe how upset I am with this purchase!!!!! It pictures 4 sculls with crystal mohawks! Which is precisely why I bought this product I received one school and it definitely did not have a crystal mohawk. I feel that it was completely misrepresented by the photos and what was written.
